quiz.question_id: Mengapa `counter++` bukan operasi yang aman secara concurrent?
quiz.question_en: Why is `counter++` not safe as a concurrent operation?
options_id: Karena operator `++` hanya berlaku untuk channel
Karena itu adalah operasi read-modify-write yang tidak atomic
Karena integer di Go tidak bisa ditulis oleh goroutine
Karena compiler menghapus operator `++` saat runtime
options_en: Because the `++` operator only applies to channels
Because it is a read-modify-write operation that is not atomic
Because Go integers cannot be written by goroutines
Because the compiler removes the `++` operator at runtime

quiz.question_en: What is the core guarantee provided by `sync.Mutex`?
options_id: Hanya satu goroutine yang bisa berada di critical section pada satu waktu
Semua goroutine bisa membaca dan menulis bersamaan
options_en: Only one goroutine can be in the critical section at a time
All goroutines can read and write simultaneously
A mutex automatically detects all deadlocks
A mutex replaces the need for a `WaitGroup`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa method `Value()` juga mengunci mutex meski hanya membaca?
quiz.question_en: Why does the `Value()` method also lock the mutex even though it only reads?
options_id: Karena `return` di Go harus berada di dalam mutex
Karena method pembaca selalu lebih cepat bila memakai lock
Karena `RWMutex` tidak boleh dipakai untuk read
Karena pembacaan juga harus disinkronkan jika bisa terjadi bersamaan dengan penulisan
options_en: Because `return` in Go must happen inside a mutex
Because reader methods are always faster with a lock
Because `RWMutex` cannot be used for reads
Because reads must also be synchronized if they can happen concurrently with writes

quiz.question_en: When is `sync.RWMutex` a better fit than `sync.Mutex`?
options_id: Saat data sering dibaca tetapi jarang ditulis
options_en: When the data is never read
When every operation is a write
When the data is read frequently but written rarely
When there is only one goroutine

quiz.question_id: Method mana yang dipakai reader saat menggunakan `sync.RWMutex`?
quiz.question_en: Which methods does a reader use with `sync.RWMutex`?
options_en: `Lock()` and `Unlock()` only
`RLock()` and `RUnlock()`
`Wait()` and `Done()`
`Read()` and `Close()`

quiz.question_id: Perintah mana yang menjalankan race detector saat testing?
quiz.question_en: Which command runs the race detector during testing?
options_en: `go test ./... -sync`
`go run -detect main.go`
`go test -race ./...`
`go vet -race ./...`

quiz.question_id: Menurut tabel lesson, shared cache atau shared state lebih cocok dilindungi dengan?
quiz.question_en: According to the lesson table, shared cache or shared state is better protected with?
options_en: A large channel buffer

quiz.question_id: Menurut tabel lesson, counter sederhana biasanya memakai?
quiz.question_en: According to the lesson table, a simple counter usually uses?
options_en: Only a channel
Only an `RWMutex`
A `select` with `default`

quiz.question_en: Why is `defer c.mu.Unlock()` placed immediately after `c.mu.Lock()`?
options_id: Agar lock tetap dilepas meski fungsi return lebih awal atau panic
Agar method bisa dipanggil tanpa pointer receiver
options_en: So the lock becomes a shared lock
So the compiler can optimize the mutex
So the lock is still released even if the function returns early or panics
So the method can be called without a pointer receiver
